rows.title: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
rows.summary: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that Company has received a Letter of Empanelment from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited for 10,000 Off-Grid Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems (SPWPS) pumps. The total value of the 10,000 pumps is around Rs. 235.92 Crores (inclusive of GST).
